name: Defenders of Darrowshire
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Many of the defenders fell at the battle of Darrowshire.  And many roam again as the ghastly servants of the Scourge!  Find these poor souls and end their misery!

Hunt cannibal ghouls, gibbering ghouls and diseased flayers.  Many of these fiends were once the good folk of Darrowshire and destroying their forms now will set their souls free.

You will find them in Plaguewood and Corin's Crossing, and in other Scourge strongholds of Eastern Plaguelands.
narrative.objectives: Free 15 Darrowshire Spirits and return to Carlin Redpath.
narrative.offerRewardText: It is good to hear you found the tortured souls of my brethren and freed them. My heart will weep less, knowing at least some of the defenders of Darrowshire no longer wallow in the vile subservience of the Scourge.
narrative.requestItemsText: The poor defenders of Darrowshire cry out to me in my dreams, adventurer. You must free them!

chain.subtitle: 5 quests from level 55 to 56, 14,700 XP in all.
